title: Samsung WF6000R — Diagnostic code display
description: Review stored diagnostic codes (up to 7 digits) from Smart Install.

steps.title: Diagnostic information display
steps.body: From AS: press first bottom-right button → CR display → jog dial CW for up to 7 stored codes (latest first).
